Interface TransactionService

All Known Implementing Classes:
TransactionServiceImpl
public interface TransactionService
Service interface for transaction processing and management operations. Handles transaction processing, receipt generation, sales analytics, and data persistence.

  • Method Details

    • processTransaction

      Transaction processTransaction(Cart cart, double paymentAmount, int pointsToRedeem)
      Processes a transaction from a cart, handling payment and points redemption.
      Parameters:
      cart - the cart containing items to purchase
      paymentAmount - the amount paid by the customer
      pointsToRedeem - the number of loyalty points to redeem
      Returns:
      the processed Transaction object

    • generateReceipt

      String generateReceipt(Transaction transaction)

      Parameters:
      transaction - the transaction to generate a receipt for
      Returns:
      a formatted receipt string

    • saveReceiptToFile

      boolean saveReceiptToFile(Transaction transaction, String filePath) throws IOException
      Saves a transaction receipt to a file.
      Parameters:
      transaction - the transaction to save
      filePath - the file path where the receipt should be saved
      Returns:
      true if the save operation was successful, false otherwise
      Throws:
      IOException - if an I/O error occurs during file writing
